items.name: Dobbs Ferry Double-Double 2026
items.information:
Thursday, October 22nd: 2x2x2 Cube and 3x3x3 Blindfolded
Friday, October 23rd: 4x4x4 Cube and Pyraminx

There will be a **separate 20-person limit** for each event. If every individual event has already reached its limit, no further registrations will be accepted, even if the overall limit of 40 hasn't been reached.
